notes: Topline: Cerberus is a mid-to-large contact center focused on payment disputes and patient billing (PCI + PHI in scope). They want agent-assist that surfaces policy snippets, generates suggested responses, and can invoke tool-calls to update tickets / issue refunds. Key quote from Director of Support: "We cannot have model outputs touching raw PHI unless it's strictly controlled and logged." Requirements: VPC/private deployment for PHI paths, strong KMS/HSM, full audit trail (immutable logs for 7+ years), SSO/SAML + SCIM, per-route retention controls; need offline/on-prem option for highest-sensitivity flows. Performance: need reliability under spikes (end-of-month billing spikes) — plan for auto-burst to dedicated capacity and deterministic fallback to smaller quantized model. Cost sensitivity but willing to pay for predictable capacity for peak windows. Integration notes: Genesys cloud telephony + ServiceNow ticket updates + internal CRM; prefer function-calling for ticket actions (close, refund, tag). POC details: ingest 18k recent transcripts, evaluate summarization quality (accuracy > 92% for SLA summaries), run load test simulating 200 concurrent active agents with 40 msg/s peak. Next docs shared: pricing deck and security FAQ. Action items: legal to review DPA, SE to map network egress for VPC/private agent lanes, schedule production spike test.
